body:
Deal: Staub Swarovski Diamond Knob Round Stainless Steel $79.60 (60% off $199) + Shipping ($0 with $100 Order) @ Zwilling Australia

[m00seTheC0wSnake] It is stainless steel and heat resistant up to 220 degrees C, so can easily handle a hot poop chute. I say, “Treat yo’self!’
[Wiadro] i came here to say the same thing but you said it
[Frackingiscool] Everything is a butt plug if you're determined.
[node modules] It can be a beginners one for training. Start small then gradually increase the size.
[Cupa Bundy Drinker] Does it come with a pointy tip for those who can't afford Staub cookware?
[Fergy1987] The poem is the only thing that makes sense in this deal
[Zitane] As a man, i rarely cry. But i did today. Twas beautiful poem
[freewhere] So steel and glass? surprised they didn't call it sterling silver and or would have been too obvious.
[sobriety22] So when is someone going to post a deal on a Staub? Need the pairing because I'm not using this for what it sounds like the more adventurous types around here are going to use it for. A bit of bedazzling.
[cashless] Would normally jump onto an offer like this.
But I think I’ll sit on this one
[FrugalNotStingy] +1 just for the poem!
the house was two point three million,
the knob was $79.60:
Finally, something I can afford to screw.
Pity, the last three lines don't rhyme 😓
[browser] Man made glass disguise as crystal and now pretend to be diamond, buying one to use as a knob taking a fool's jewellery to the next level.
